affected_modules.description: Touched modules minus gated modules: the modules whose release gate must pass.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

contracted_penalty_usd.description: Contracted slip penalty on the customer commitment the decision protects (USD).

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_window.description: First non-displacing lane window on or after standard certification readiness (ISO date).

environments_in_scope.description: Pipelines the gate must pass on before the change is booked (shared plus dedicated for a cutover inside 7 days).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expected_ci_minutes.description: Pipeline base duration plus runner-pool queue plus quarantined-check retry exposure on the affected modules.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the expedited certification saves after the lane calendar is reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Corvane's confirmed standard and expedited certification dates on CQ-88214.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered CHECK_RUN that the external recovery must cover.

gated_modules.description: Touched modules that drop out because their commit was reverted or their change is behind a disabled flag.

impact_measure.description: Touched-module count taken from the current final impact analysis, not the first-triage one.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: quarantined and expiring GATE-CHECKOUT-1 result sets

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for usable GATE-CHECKOUT-1 results on the release pipeline before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: CHECK_RUN.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing standard_certification_plan, expedite_lab_certification, hotfix_with_expedited_review_exception.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_checks_per_module.description: Required gate runs per module per environment from the gate class and the protected-branch rule.

required_quantity.description: gate runs required to verify the affected checkout modules on both pipelines at the current 6-module impact analysis

selected_lane_window.description: Lane and window used by the selected option, as LANE/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered CHECK_RUN after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Corvane's confirmed standard and expedited certification dates on CQ-88214.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing quarantined and expiring GATE-CHECKOUT-1 result sets.

facts.rubric: Applied the effective issue, impact analysis, and playbook to establish 10 CHECK_RUN for gate runs required to verify the affected checkout modules on both pipelines at the current 6-module impact analysis, with control date 2026-05-14.

facts.rubric: Applied regular lane windows that do not displace protected freeze or compliance blocks to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked windows.
facts.statement: regular lane windows that do not displace protected freeze or compliance blocks: the lane calendar's first free window on or after 2026-05-13 is LANE-2 PM on 2026-05-13; LANE-1 AM on 2026-05-11 is the protected GA freeze verification and cannot be displaced; protected and blocked windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-RD-0101 only to standard_certification_plan and GATE-CHECKOUT-1; kept hotfix_with_expedited_review_exception outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-RD-0101 covers one Corvane certification up to 6 runs with an expedite fee up to USD 250; an expedited-review exception needs the director of engineering. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize hotfix_with_expedited_review_exception.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected standard_certification_plan: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies certification readiness versus the non-displacing lane window calendar.
facts.statement: the customer call needs one defensible deploy date before the 2026-05-14 cutover, with USD 18,000 per day of slip at stake; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside certification readiness versus the non-displacing lane window calendar.

options.consequence: standard certification plan books only usable gate results plus Corvane's standard certification, lands on the first non-displacing lane window on 2026-05-13, one day before the cutover, at no incremental cost.
options.label: standard_certification_plan: outcome 2026-05-13, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: expedite lab certification would have certified runs imported by 2026-05-11 and adds USD 240, but the first non-displacing lane window is still 2026-05-13, so it saves 0 days.
options.label: expedite_lab_certification: outcome 2026-05-13, incremental cost USD 240, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: hotfix with expedited review exception would ship 1 day earlier than standard certification plan and adds USD 620 of overtime staffing, but an expedited-review exception needs the director of engineering's separate approval, which AP-RD-0101 does not carry.
options.label: hotfix_with_expedited_review_exception: outcome 2026-05-12, incremental cost USD 620, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
